headline: Garmin’s new Fenix 9 adds brighter screens and smoother map panning
summary: Garmin launched its new Fenix 9 smartwatches with OLED displays. Features include 3,000 nits brightness and 50% more RAM. Starting price for the 43mm model is $999.99.

headline: Trump is upping the price of Big Tech’s favorite visa
summary: DHS announced a fee increase to over $103,000 for H-1B visas. The State Department plans to revoke visas for up to 200,000 asylum seekers. This policy impacts Big Tech's preferred visa type and asylum seekers.

headline: At just $8, you owe it to yourself to grab Inscryption
summary: Daniel Mullins' critically acclaimed deckbuilder, Inscryption, is on sale for $8. This discount is available via Humble for the Steam version. A great opportunity to experience the unique game from the creator of Pony Island 2.

headline: The Witcher 3 is getting a remaster
summary: CD Projekt Red is remastering The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt for a September 29th launch. The updated RPG will feature improved visuals, combat, and a reimagined skill tree. It will also include the first two expansions.

headline: Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups Review
summary: Review finds 'Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups' to be a sloppy gangster epic. Indian megastar Yash delivers a blood-soaked performance. The film explores mature themes in a chaotic narrative.

headline: Showa American Story: The First Hands-On Preview
summary: 'Showa American Story' crafts an unforgettable, eccentric B-movie world. Its general polish and combat depth lag behind modern AAA action games. Despite flaws, it's shaping up to be a unique and fascinating ride.

headline: The Baseus 25,000mAh 140W Laptop Power Bank With Dual USB-C Cables Drops to Just $45.29
summary: The Baseus 25,000mAh 140W Laptop Power Bank is on sale for $45.29. It includes dual USB-C cables for versatile charging options. No Amazon Prime membership is required to access this discount.

headline: The Dog Stars Review
summary: Review of Ridley Scott's post-apocalyptic survivor drama 'The Dog Stars.' The film is criticized for emotionally distancing itself from grief. It's described as keeping feelings in 'a triple layer of emotional bubble wrap.'

headline: How Dolly Parton told her life story through six iconic songs
summary: Dolly Parton's life story is explored through a selection of six iconic songs. Her music addresses themes of love, loss, and female empowerment. The feature highlights her legendary status as a singer-songwriter.

headline: Household energy bills to hit three-year high as Ofgem announces 4% rise from October
summary: Ofgem announced a 4% rise in household energy bills starting in October. A typical household will pay an additional £60 per year. This increase marks a three-year high for energy costs.

headline: NHS failing child sex abuse victims in adulthood, say psychiatrists
summary: Psychiatrists report the NHS is failing adult survivors of child sex abuse. A new, damning report cites decades of mistreatment and mismanagement. Experts call for improved support for those seeking help later in life.

headline: Dad of woman who took her own life says Treasury failed in its duty of care
summary: Chloe Moffat died by suicide after facing allegations of sharing confidential information. Her father claims the Treasury failed in its duty of care. Moffat had denied the allegations made against her.
